Project and original-author technology marks

These names and logos identify their respective projects. They are not original
artwork of this icon collection. Source URLs, chosen variants, and source hashes
are recorded per mark in assets/icons/catalog.json.

C: distributed by the C language homepage, https://www.c-language.org/.
No claim of a unique ISO-designated logo is made.
C++: Standard C++ Foundation, https://github.com/isocpp/logos.
C#: Microsoft / .NET authors, https://github.com/dotnet/brand.
The repository illustration license is not asserted as a blanket logo license.
Python: Python Software Foundation / CPython contributors,
https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/main/PC/icons/logo.svg.
https://www.python.org/community/logos/ and https://www.python.org/psf/trademarks/.
TypeScript: Microsoft, https://www.typescriptlang.org/branding/.
Kotlin: Kotlin Foundation, https://kotlinfoundation.org/guidelines/.
PostgreSQL: distributed by the PostgreSQL project. The registered trademark
owner is the PostgreSQL Community Association of Canada,
https://wiki.postgresql.org/wiki/Logo and https://www.postgresql.org/about/policies/trademarks/.
Kubernetes: CNCF / Kubernetes authors, https://github.com/cncf/artwork.
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/logo/LICENSE supplies
Apache-2.0 or CC-BY-4.0 for the logo; trademark policies still apply.
Docker: Docker, Inc., https://www.docker.com/company/newsroom/media-resources/.
Git: Jason Long, https://git-scm.com/community/logos, CC BY 3.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/.
GitHub: GitHub, Inc., current Invertocat distribution,
https://brand.github.com/foundations/logo and https://brand.github.com/GitHub_Logos.zip.
LinkedIn: LinkedIn Corporation, complete inbug-blue-28 symbol used on the
official brand website, https://brand.linkedin.com/in-logo. This web variant
already contains transparent counters and has no separate registration glyph.
Node.js: OpenJS Foundation / Node.js contributors, official Hex distribution,
https://nodejs.org/static/logos/nodejsHex.svg and https://nodejs.org/en/about/branding.
The OpenJS trademark policy applies: https://trademark-policy.openjsf.org/.
Spring: Broadcom, official standalone leaf, https://spring.io/img/spring.svg.
Spring and its logo are trademarks of Broadcom. https://spring.io/trademarks/.
Software licenses do not grant blanket rights to these trademarks.
NGINX: F5 / NGINX, standalone N symbol group from the official logo lockup,
https://nginx.org/img/nginx_logo.svg and https://www.f5.com/company/policies/trademarks.
Redis: Redis Ltd., three-layer cube from the project documentation repository,
https://github.com/redis/docs/blob/main/static/images/redis-cube.svg and
https://redis.io/legal/trademark-policy/.

Treatment: icon-only variants are selected from original project distributions;
geometry and palette are retained and proportional fit/centering is applied.
GitHub's monochrome identity uses the shared neutral foreground for readable
light/dark presentation. Existing monochrome APIs use negative internal marks;
these render adaptations are distinct from the original color distributions.
The Kotlin, C#, and Node.js gradients are converted to static paint steps for
the current SVG renderer. Node.js uses 512 sRGB samples per gradient and masks
for the original clipped faces; the source geometry and gradient stops remain
the comparison reference. Monochrome
API presentations are compatibility variants and are not claimed to be separate
official color assets. No extra decorative background is added.

JavaScript is the community logo distributed by its original authors / JSConf,
not an Ecma-designated official mark. https://github.com/voodootikigod/logo.js
